ios.desc:
Topics is a reading app where articles are sorted by subject instead of by feed. You can pick a topic you actually care about, read a good-quality articles, essays, blog posts, and papers about it without distractions, and even add articles from anywhere else on the internet.

There are about a hundred and twenty topics, from Can We Talk to Animals? to Horror Stories or the Roman Empire.r

• Add external articles and read them without ads, popups or clutter
• Build your own reading collections
• Practice vocabulary: highlight a word, see what it means, save it for later
• Follow the writers you trust and read only them
• Track reading time and see your progress
• Share what you are reading in the feed, or keep it to yourself
• Open another reader's profile and follow them

This app exists because choosing what to read has become tiring, and because most of what gets published is optimizing for something other than being worth your time.
